answer: Every identity posts a 12,000 POA bond in the orchard vault before claiming emissions. The wharf router samples 100 settlement routes each epoch and matches signature fingerprints, flagging any duplicate cluster within a single round. When a flag lands, the flagged bond halves and the remainder pays the reporters; a reef of clones therefore bleeds 6,000 POA per fake identity on the first flag, 3,000 on the second, while honest nodes pay nothing.
